Eligible Visa cardholders of participating financial institutions can now securely add their cards to Google Wallet and make fast, convenient, and secure payments across millions of contactless acceptance […] The post Google Pay Now Available to Visa Card Holders in Nigeria for Fast, Secure Digital Payments appeared first on BellaNaija - Showcasing Africa to the world.
